title: OA EXPLANATION OF MONTHLY EVENTS - the twenty-eight events explained with their durations, chances and effects, plus the worked example and the rerollable-monthly rule
audit_label: R700 OA monthly events prose audit
audit_comment: OA round eighty-seven (capture pp. 243-247): the Explanation of Monthly Events - the twenty-eight Table 72 events explained with their durations, chances and effects, plus the worked example and the player-character interaction rules, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA EXPLANATION OF MONTHLY EVENTS, printed capture pp. 243-247 - the monthly explanations round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE EXPLANATIONS: the twenty-eight monthly events of Table 72 explained with their durations, chances and effects - the Accident of the DM's choice ranging inconvenience to calamity; the Bad Harvest of the 25% incomes, the 5% famine and the 50% food blamed on the ruler; the Bad Weather halving movement with the 15% desertions; the Bandit Activity of the 20-200, the spies and the boast rule; the Birth of the 95/5 and the nine months; the Death with the 30% heirless succession and the 2-7-week official; the Minor Earthquake of the 5-mile radius and the 20/30 fires; the Excessive Taxes of the 30/70; the Famous Person staying his quiet 1d6 weeks; the Minor Fire of the 10-40/50-70/80-100; the Flooding of the 5d4-foot wave; the Haunting real or not; the Horrendous Monster worshipped when unbeaten; the Incursions sudden and permanent; the Injustice of the 5/20 accusations; the Landslide of the hills and the weeks; the Maiden of Virtue of the 50/30/10/10 and the 13s; the Major Battle for the BATTLESYSTEM; the Maneater striking 1-2 a week; the Marriage accepted; the Notorious Criminal rumored; the Plague seen to the yearly; the Recruiting of the 20% sweep; the Troop Movements of the 10/40; the Uprising of the 10/60/70/70; the Vengeful Stranger finding 70%; the VIP in disguise. THE RIGIDITY: the monthly events rerolled when the player characters change the course, the yearly event NEVER rerolled. THE WORKED EXAMPLE: the T'u Lung year of the 82 Rebellion, the month 5, the 3-month duration, the 4/3/5 column split. The prose codifies per the R431 calculus
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 153 closed, 82 open - the Monthly Events prose box flips (census 622 -> 623); NEXT - R701: Table 73 the daily events grid (capture p. 247), prefix djo (verify free at the landing), audit "R701 OA daily events audit", include after rules/oa72explain.h
